page: Microsoft Azure M48lds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The configuration is powered by dedicated x86_64 Intel processors providing 48 vCPUs. Memory capacity measures 768.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a dense allocation ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware graphics acceleration is not included.

The instance integrates 1772 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage configurations. This onboard NVMe volume provides direct-attached, low-latency disk capacity suitable for scratch space, temporary operational databases, and caching layers. The configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring dedicated network interface provisioning for external routing.

With a 16:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, the resource balance prioritizes RAM capacity and fast local I/O over compute concentration. This configuration provides a cost-efficient deployment profile for memory-bound workloads that do not require multi-terabyte memory classes. Primary workload fits include relational database management systems, in-memory caching solutions, enterprise extract-transform-load (ETL) routines, and large-scale data analytics pipelines.
